Ava (People Ops): Hey team, quick heads-up — we have a visiting engineer on Thursday (9:30am) who'll be doing remote onboarding and expecting their welcome swag. The concierge put a box in Cabinet C but it's locked and I don't have the key.
FrontDeskBot: New delivery logged: 'Onboarding Kit - Redwood Swag' from ShipCo. Stored at Cabinet C slot 2. Locker status: locked.
mike: I put the keycard in my bag last night, will be out until 11. Can someone pop by the office to open it? :grimacing: 
lina: I can swing by at 10:15. Do we need to label the swag with the visitor's name? Also, will they need a guest badge?
Ava (People Ops): Thanks Lina. Yes, guest badge needed. Name is Jordan Park, email jordan@acme.org. Could we also check the kit includes the power adapter? Last onboarding kit was missing it.
mike: Thanks — and FYI the kit has a mini power brick + USB-C cable usually. I'll ask the courier to confirm contents in the note.
FrontDeskBot: Guest pre-registered: Jordan Park, 9:30-12:00, host: mike. Guest badge will be printed upon arrival if flagged 'guest' by host.
lina: On it. I'll open Cabinet C and put the kit on the front desk with a sticky 'Jordan Park - 9:30' tag. Also can someone confirm the fridge has space? They asked for a small perishable snack to be chilled.
Ava (People Ops): There's a marked 'visitor shelf' in fridge. Please don't mix with team lunches. Labelled bags only.
mike: Also heads up — the lanyards are in Drawer 4, second compartment. Use the blue lanyard for contractors.
lina: Found the kit. Missing the adapter. Courier left a small sticky note 'adapter shipped separately'. I called shipco and they say adapter will arrive today, not tracked. I left the kit at front desk and put a 'missing adapter' note.
Ava (People Ops): Great, thank you. Jordan is remote but may swing by to pick up. If adapter doesn't arrive, we can loan a spare adapter from IT. @IT Support could someone preemptively lend a USB-C adapter to Front Desk?
IT Support: @Ava - putting a spare adapter in Front Desk kit now. Also can we switch badge printing to 'temp lanyard' so they can come in quickly?
Ava (People Ops): Yes please, temp lanyard is fine. Mike — can you confirm arrival channel? Will Jordan ring the buzzer or meet at the lobby?
mike: He said he'll buzz. I'll be on the call so maybe Lina can hand off when he arrives.
lina: Will do. Added a sticky: 'Jordan - buzz & collect'.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Small note for records: I'll update the visitor log with 'swag kit missing adapter, loaned spare adapter from IT'.
FrontDeskBot: Visitor check-out reminder scheduled at 12:05. End of thread.
